pages.text: Hunt for $(bold)29 custom enchantments$() beyond the $(thing)Apotheosis$() and vanilla pools: 24 general-purpose ones from enchanting and loot, plus 5 planetary ones whose books lie in chests on their planet.$(br2)All of them are real enchantments and work with every Apotheosis system.

pages.title: Dimensional Survival
pages.text: $(bold)Heatward$(): Fire/lava resistance, scaling with level$(br)$(bold)Voidward$(): Void damage reduction$(br)$(bold)Depthstrider$(): Pressure/depth damage resistance$(br)$(bold)Aether Acclimation$(): Thin-air resistance high in the Aether (Tier 4)$(br)$(bold)Warp Shield$(): Teleportation effect resistance$(br2)$(italic)You need these for $(t3)Tier 3$()+ dimensional content.$()

pages.title: Resource & Combat
pages.text: $(bold)Prospector$(): Passive ore detection$(br)$(bold)Lumberjack$(): Tree-felling area$(br2)$(bold)Momentum$(): Damage scales with movement speed$(br)$(bold)Adrenaline$(): Low-HP damage boost$(br)$(bold)Titan Slayer$(): Bonus damage to large/boss mobs$(br)$(bold)Crowd Control$(): +5% damage a level per extra hostile nearby$(br)$(bold)Adaptive$(): Resists the damage type that last hit you$(br)$(bold)Primal Force$(): +3% damage a level per 5 food saturation

pages.title: Boss & Path Synergy
pages.text: $(bold)Boss Ward$(): Less damage from boss entities$(br)$(bold)Steadfast$(): Knockback immunity$(br)$(bold)Nemesis$(): Tracks kills; bonus damage against bosses you have fought before$(br2)$(bold)Mana Temper$(): Your spells power up the weapon$(br)$(bold)RF Capacitance$(): Stored RF boosts damage$(br)$(bold)Convergence$(): A bonus when you wear tech and magic gear together

pages.title: Utility
pages.text: $(bold)Magnetism$(): Item pickup radius$(br)$(bold)Last Stand$(): a hit that would kill you leaves you at 1 HP instead, once every 5 minutes$(br)$(bold)Vitality$(): Max HP boost$(br)$(bold)Phalanx$(): 6% less damage a level while you block with a shield$(br)$(bold)Quick Draw$(): Draws the bow or crossbow you hold 15% faster a level$(br2)$(bold)Next: $(l:icraft:systems/apotheosis_enchanting)Apotheosis Enchanting$(/l); better shelves give better rolls.$()

pages.title: Planet Enchants
pages.text: Chests on each Ad Astra planet hold its enchanted book: level I in 30% of them, level II in 10%.$(br2)$(bold)Lunar Stride$() (Moon): Jump Boost, and a third less fall damage a level.$(br)$(bold)Thermal Regulation$() (Mars): a third less of the planets' cold damage a level; only a space suit stops freezing.$(br)$(bold)Pressure Shell$() (Venus): half the acid damage a level, and no slowdown at 2.

pages.title: Planet Enchants, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Void Adaptation$() (Glacio): removes Glacio's mining fatigue.$(br)$(bold)Stellar Shield$() (Mercury): a third less fire damage a level on planets.$(br2)Levels on different armor pieces add up, and 3 stop the hazard.$(br2)$(bold)Collect these on early planets to survive later ones.$()
